key_insight: A mixture-of-experts framework with generative diffusion models can generalize physical-layer security strategies across diverse wireless scenarios by selecting and combining scenario-specialized experts.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path toward 6G secure beamforming that reduces the need for repeated optimization and improves robustness under changing network conditions.
method: Select representative scenarios and train scenario-specific GDM experts for secure beamforming with artificial noise.
Use a lightweight gating network on channel features to recognize scenarios and choose the most relevant experts.
Fuse top expert outputs with an attention-based combiner to produce a high-fidelity security strategy for unseen cases.
evidence_signal: Simulations indicate the model can accurately recognize scenarios, select experts effectively, and maintain near-optimal secrecy rates across a range of wireless conditions.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of representative scenarios and feature engineering for gating, which may limit transfer if deployment conditions differ substantially from training.
paper_title: Unlocking Cross-Scenario Physical Layer Security: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Generative Diffusion Models
